title: 道法自然之思
text: 何谓真正的无为？此问萦绕心头，久而未决。翻阅道德经，只见字里行间透着一股清冽之气。老子主张顺应天时，不强求于物。世人常陷于名利之薮，终日奔波，却不知如此反为自困。若能效法上水，处众人之所恶，方能至高。水之柔弱，竟可穿石，此乃至柔克刚之理。人生在世，往往执迷于掌控，试图以此抵御变故。然天道运行，自有其律，强行干预徒增烦恼。与其在喧嚣中苦苦支撑，不如在静谧中观照内心。虚心若谷，方能纳万物之精。摒弃冗余之欲，灵魂得以轻盈。当人不再执着于结果，过程便成了一种修行。顺势而为，犹如鱼游于水，鸟翔于空。这种状态并非消极遁世，而是更高维度的进取。在无为中实现有为，是极其精妙的平衡。正如春雨润物，不露声色却能促成万物生长。懂得退后一步，往往能看清全局。与其在争端中损耗心神，不如在淡然中积蓄力量。这种智慧在当代社会显得尤为珍贵。它教导我们接纳残缺，拥抱未知。当内心与宇宙共振，焦虑自然烟消云散。此时，万物皆在其中，而我亦在其中。这种超然的境界，正是古圣先贤留给后世的瑰宝。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does water's softness illustrate?
options: Softness cannot affect anything hard
Softness can pierce stone, showing that the soft overcomes the hard
Water evaporates too quickly to matter
Water has no real power

questions.prompt: According to the text, what happens when a person stops clinging to outcomes?
options: They lose all motivation
The process itself becomes a form of spiritual practice
They become careless
They give up on their goals entirely

questions.prompt: The passage compares effortless, quiet influence to which natural phenomenon?
options: A thunderstorm
Spring rain nourishing things silently
A drought
An earthquake

questions.prompt: According to the final part of the passage, what does this ancient wisdom teach us?
options: To pursue perfection at all costs
To accept imperfection and embrace the unknown
To avoid all risk
To always control our surroundings

questions.prompt: What advice attributed to Laozi does the author mention?
options: Compete fiercely in order to succeed
Follow the natural order of things instead of forcing outcomes
Accumulate as much wealth as possible
Always seek a position of high status

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
